snippet.title: Alpha Release Date Trailer | Warhammer 40,000: Dark Heresy
snippet.description:
Watch the Alpha Release Date Trailer for Warhammer 40,000: Dark Heresy — a party-based, story-driven cRPG from Owlcat Games. As an acolyte of the Inquisition, lead investigations, uncover vast conspiracies, master tactical combat, and make decisive choices in service of the God-Emperor. The Alpha launches on December 16 on PC (Steam). 

Join the Inquisition:
Wishlist Warhammer 40,000: Dark Heresy on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3710600/Warhammer_40000_Dark_Heresy/
Pre-order Warhammer 40,000: Dark Heresy on our website:
https://darkheresy.owlcat.games/
